race.description: Nutrien Equine Nsw Breeders Challenge 2yo Fillies Heat - Round 2
race.comment: ATOMIK GO ANNA (2) kicked off her campaign with an easy win at Wagga before chasing a smart one to place in a heat of this series last time out. Led in both of those outings so has the speed to take advantage of the low draw. SHOWEMHOW (6) has been solid in two outings at Bathurst since a win at Young. Was fourth to the good filly Shes A Delaney two back before a midfield finish from the back row last time. Can be competitive here. HIGHVIEW BONNIE (3) draws lower than in recent attempts so could show more while YOUR SHUFFLE (7) broke the maiden last start and could play a role.
